shoot.name: Shoot
shoot.summary: Six classes · three maps · slide hopping · AI battles

variants.title: Keep moving. Find your angle.
variants.copy: A block-world FPS with jump-and-slide momentum, six weapon classes and three original maps. Every corner changes the fight.

variants.title: Pick a class. Make your shot.
variants.copy: Assault, Hunter, Runner, Breacher, Heavy and Marksman. Headshots, reloads, recoil, cover and quick respawns.

variants.title: Your map. Your rules.
variants.copy: Free for all, team deathmatch and rotating hardpoint. Three AI levels, Random settings and a practice range.

variants.title: Two thumbs. One crosshair.
variants.copy: Large independent movement, look and fire controls. Mouse lock, drag aiming, keyboard and saved match statistics.

features: Jump, slide, carry momentum and use cover. Original block maps, six classes and headshot combat.
Free for all, team deathmatch or hardpoint against three AI difficulties. Random options and a training range.
Mouse, keyboard and big touch controls. Weapon colours, XP, career saves and three downloadable mods.
mods: Lower gravity makes jumps longer for every combatant.
Unlimited loaded ammunition for both sides; weapon fire rates still apply.
All combatants move 35% faster, including jumps and sliding approaches.
